stem.text: **J** is a salt of one of the halogens chlorine, bromine, iodine or astatine.
The reaction scheme shows a series of reactions using a solution of **J** as the starting reagent.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme. J(aq) goes to a precipitate with HNO3(aq) and AgNO3(aq) (horizontal arrow). The precipitate goes to a colourless solution with an excess of dilute NH3(aq) (horizontal arrow). A vertical arrow from the colourless solution, labelled 'an excess of HNO3(aq)', points down to a precipitate.
